definition: Endodontics is the dental specialty concerned with the pulp and tissues surrounding the tooth root, including diagnosis and treatment of related disease or injury.
entry_text: Endodontics is the dental specialty concerned with the pulp and tissues surrounding the tooth root, including diagnosis and treatment of related disease or injury.
example: An endodontist evaluates an infected tooth to determine whether root canal treatment can preserve it.
label: Endodontics
